package.name: @ai-ecoverse/slicc-cdp
package.description: SLICC's CDP layer: client, browser API, transports, HAR, and ARIA snapshot

scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --release --target wasm32-wasip1 -p slicc-cdp -p curlwright && mkdir -p bin && cp target/wasm32-wasip1/release/playwright-cli.wasm bin/playwright-cli.wasm && cp target/wasm32-wasip1/release/curlwright.wasm bin/curlwright.wasm
scripts.typecheck: node --check src/index.js && node --check src/cdp-client.js && node --check src/connect.js && node --check src/page.js && node --check packages/sliccy-browser/src/browser.js && node --check packages/sliccy-browser/src/fetch-script.js && node --check packages/sliccy-browser/src/ws-router.js
scripts.test:integration: PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo test --workspace && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo build -p slicc-cdp -p curlwright && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo build --target wasm32-wasip1 -p slicc-cdp -p curlwright && npx playwright-core install chromium && node --test --test-timeout=600000 test/integration/*.test.mjs

cargo.manifest:
[package]
name = "slicc-cdp-client"
version = "0.0.0"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.83"
license = "Apache-2.0"
description = "Shared CDP connection for slicc-cdp CLIs"
repository = "https://github.com/ai-ecoverse/slicc-cdp"
homepage = "https://github.com/ai-ecoverse/slicc-cdp"
readme = "README.md"
keywords = ["cdp", "chrome", "devtools", "websocket"]
categories = ["development-tools", "network-programming"]
publish = true

[lib]
name = "cdp_client"

[dependencies]
serde_json = "1"
slicc-browsers = { version = "1.5", features = ["serde"] }
url = "2.5"
wasix-net = "0.1"

[target.'cfg(not(target_os = "wasi"))'.dependencies]
native-tls = "0.2"

[target.'cfg(all(target_os = "linux", target_env = "musl"))'.dependencies]
openssl = { version = "0.10", features = ["vendored"] }

[dev-dependencies]
slicc-browsers = { version = "1.5", features = ["corpus"] }

[package]
name = "slicc-discovery"
version = "0.0.0"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.83"
license = "Apache-2.0"
description = "Discovery engine for agent-facing web standards"
repository = "https://github.com/ai-ecoverse/slicc-cdp"
homepage = "https://github.com/ai-ecoverse/slicc-cdp"
keywords = ["discovery", "web-standards", "link-header", "well-known"]
categories = ["web-programming", "parser-implementations"]
publish = true

[lib]
name = "discovery"

[dependencies]
psl = "2"
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"
url = "2.5"

[package]
name = "slicc-cdp"
version = "0.0.0"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.88"
license = "Apache-2.0"
description = "SLICC CDP client; installs the playwright-cli command"
repository = "https://github.com/ai-ecoverse/slicc-cdp"
homepage = "https://github.com/ai-ecoverse/slicc-cdp"
readme = "README.md"
keywords = ["cdp", "chrome", "devtools", "browser"]
categories = ["command-line-utilities", "development-tools"]
publish = true

[lib]
name = "slicc_cdp"

[[bin]]
name = "playwright-cli"
path = "src/main.rs"

[dependencies]
cdp-client = { package = "slicc-cdp-client", path = "../cdp-client", version = "0.0.0" }
discovery = { package = "slicc-discovery", path = "../discovery", version = "0.0.0" }
image = { version = "0.25.8", default-features = false, features = ["png"] }
serde_json = "1"
slicc-browsers = { version = "1.5", features = ["serde"] }
url = "2.5"

[target.'cfg(not(target_os = "wasi"))'.dependencies]
libc = "0.2"

[dev-dependencies]
slicc-browsers = { version = "1.5", features = ["corpus"] }

[package]
name = "curlwright"
version = "0.0.0"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.83"
license = "Apache-2.0"
description = "curl-style requests inside an already-open browser tab"
repository = "https://github.com/ai-ecoverse/slicc-cdp"
homepage = "https://github.com/ai-ecoverse/slicc-cdp"
readme = "README.md"
keywords = ["cdp", "chrome", "curl", "http"]
categories = ["command-line-utilities", "web-programming"]
publish = true

[[bin]]
name = "curlwright"
path = "src/main.rs"

[dependencies]
cdp-client = { package = "slicc-cdp-client", path = "../cdp-client", version = "0.0.0" }
serde_json = "1"
